name: 0046 block 6 - heater relay as its own factor
description: BLOCK 6, LAST. Block 0's stationary floor repeated while the OPERATOR TOGGLES ONLY THE HEATER RELAY (Shelly ch0) at fixed everything-else. Any step in the sensor channels on the toggle is the heater-relay coupling path, isolated from the drive -- the second coupling ticket 0035 flagged. Note the toggle times in the run notes so the steps can be located in the record. THIS PROFILE DOES NOT TOUCH THE DRIVE. The rpm schedule is deliberately empty and vfd_stop_on_end is false, so the runner never sends a frequency, never starts and never stops the motor -- the operator is in control of the drive by hand. It only acquires, for the stated duration, and logs telemetry. Ticket 0046 electrical-noise characterization. Same acquisition and scope_channels as a normal run, so blocks compare without rescaling. Heater relay must be OFF for every electrical block (it is its own EMI source, ticket 0035) -- it only comes back as its own factor in block 6.
